name: Drupal Canvas
description: Empowers content creators to build experiences by composing components, with as much freedom as site builders allow, all without needing to write code.

submodules.name: canvas_ai
submodules.purpose: AI features for Drupal Canvas (integrates drupal/ai and ai_agents to assist building/editing components and layouts). Hidden.

submodules.name: canvas_dev_ai
submodules.purpose: Experimental Canvas AI client-side orchestration loop, gated behind a feature flag; replaces the AI chat backend and UI while installed. Not for production. Depends on canvas_ai.

submodules.name: canvas_dev_cd
submodules.purpose: Feature-flag submodule enabling conflict detection and resolution in Canvas while it stabilizes.

submodules.name: canvas_dev_er
submodules.purpose: (DEPRECATED, hidden) Feature-flag enabling content-entity-reference props in the code editor.

submodules.name: canvas_dev_mode
submodules.purpose: Puts Canvas into dev mode: shows the extensions toolbar and grants access to private/internal APIs.

submodules.name: canvas_dev_translation
submodules.purpose: (DEPRECATED, hidden) Enables translation features for Canvas, useful for testing translation scenarios.

submodules.name: canvas_headless
submodules.purpose: Embeds a decoupled frontend app in the Canvas editor frame with draft-mode preview via user-bound preview tokens (RFC 7523 assertion grant). Depends on simple_oauth, consumers, custom_elements. Hidden.

submodules.name: canvas_oauth
submodules.purpose: Provides OAuth2-based authentication for Canvas's external HTTP API (built on simple_oauth >=6.0.0).

submodules.name: canvas_personalization
submodules.purpose: Adds personalization/segmentation features so component trees can vary by audience. Hidden.

submodules.name: canvas_vite
submodules.purpose: Enables Hot Module Replacement (HMR) for Canvas via a Vite dev server for code-component development. Hidden.
